A chained session that seeds nothing RECOMPUTES EVERY SEED while looking normal, so this refuses rather than burn a GPU session on finished work. seed_checkpoints() copies a file only when its NAME matches ^(seed|null)_\d+(_curve\.json|\.pt)$ -- that is, the `<kind>_<seed>.pt` and `<kind>_<seed>_curve.json` files written flat by _ckpt_path and _curve_path, for kind 'seed' or 'null' only. Two different causes produce this zero and they need opposite fixes: the mount holds no such files (check the listing below against those names), or the dataset is genuinely empty.
